displayFixtures: Preference checks use only a local own GET copy for existing learner-a: Hindi/ask/capture-response. The saved preference is never changed.
Audience vector changes only the selected cohort status to paused in learner-a own GET copy; no server cohort or permission is changed.
Unknown-pin vector changes only learner-a own original enrollment ref/version in GET display copy; saved server pins remain unchanged.

Orphan vector adds three labelled display-only rows copied from an already retained owner draft. Uses existing learner-b former author/current content-owner independent reviewer; no draft, role or reviewer assignment is stored.

Facilitator vector reduces an existing owner own display roles to facilitator and scopes one existing cohort; retained owner-only source canary must remain excluded. This is a UI model fixture, not a server-role change or facilitator authorization proof.
limits: Read-only existing synthetic trusted-header loopback accounts. No POST, protected write, new fixture, provider, third-party message, production call or hosted authentication proof.
Interceptions modify only permitted local GET display copies; display-only orphan, missing-pin and language vectors are not proof of a stored server condition.
Unsent retention is navigation/authority remount memory only; this does not claim retention through browser close or reload.
390px and CSS-root 200% text checks plus keyboard/focus are bounded layout checks; no human screen-reader conformance or farmer/MSME field usability claim.
